boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Kansas
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Lawrence food destinations with currently listed late hours on direct operator pages.

cards.title: Tacos El King
cards.subtitle: 61 23rd St at Louisiana, Lawrence
cards.notes: Check the current day’s posted closing time before leaving; this location lists evening service and late-night hours for pickup or food runs.
cards.short_summary: A south-Lawrence taco stop with service extending well past midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacos El King lists Lawrence hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 2:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Mon–Thu 4 p.m.–2 a.m.; Fri–Sat 4 p.m.–2:30 a.m. Confirm before going.

cards.title: Hawaiian Bros Island Grill
cards.subtitle: 1501 W. 23rd St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Use the location page to confirm the day’s close, then choose dine-in, pickup, delivery, or the drive-thru as available.
cards.short_summary: A 23rd Street food option with midnight and weekend 1 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Hawaiian Bros’ Lawrence location lists hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sun–Thu 11 a.m.–midnight; Fri–Sat 11 a.m.–1 a.m.; the page lists drive-thru, pickup, and delivery.

cards.title: Domino's on Iowa Street
cards.subtitle: 832 Iowa St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order through the store page and check its live Hours section, which the operator identifies as location-specific.
cards.short_summary: A central Lawrence pizza location whose official page lists 1 a.m. availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 832 Iowa Street lists the Lawrence store open until 1 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official location page displayed “Open Today Until 1:00 AM”; verify live hours before ordering.

cards.title: Domino's on West 23rd
cards.subtitle: 1008 W. 23rd St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Check the linked nearby-location listing for live hours, then use the official ordering flow for carryout or delivery from this 23rd Street store.
cards.short_summary: A second late-listed Domino’s destination on West 23rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official 832 Iowa Street page lists its nearby 1008 W. 23rd Street Lawrence location as open until 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 832 Iowa Street — nearby locations
cards.access_notes: The official nearby-locations listing displayed “Open Today Until 1:00 AM” for 1008 W. 23rd St; verify before ordering.

cards.title: Taco Bell on West 6th
cards.subtitle: 1220 W. 6th St, Lawrence
cards.notes: For the latest hours, use the official store page and note that its late drive-thru schedule differs from the dine-in schedule.
cards.short_summary: A West 6th drive-thru option with the latest listed hours in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1220 W. 6th Street.
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours: 2 a.m. Sun–Thu and 3 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in closes earlier. Confirm before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 1408 West 23rd
cards.subtitle: 1408 W. 23rd St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Use the official location page for an after-hours drive-thru visit; posted dining-room and drive-thru times are separate, so plan for the latter.
cards.short_summary: A West 23rd stop with midnight hours most nights and 1 a.m. weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists 1408 W. 23rd Street drive-thru hours until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours: midnight most nights; 1 a.m. Fri–Sat. Dine-in is listed earlier; verify before going.

cards.title: Taco Bell at Bauer Farm
cards.subtitle: 4721 Bauer Farm Dr, Lawrence
cards.notes: Check the store page immediately before a drive-thru run, especially on weekends when its official listing shows a later closing time.
cards.short_summary: A northwest Lawrence option with drive-thru hours extending into early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru service at 4721 Bauer Farm Drive until 1 a.m. most days and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 4721 Bauer Farm Drive, Lawrence
cards.access_notes: Listed drive-thru hours: 1 a.m. Sun–Thu and 2 a.m. Fri–Sat; dine-in closes earlier. Confirm before going.

cards.title: Wendy's on West 23rd
cards.subtitle: 523 W. 23rd St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Use the location page to check current conditions and choose restaurant or drive-thru service; both are currently listed through midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: An all-week, midnight-listed fast-food stop on West 23rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru hours from 8 a.m. to midnight daily at 523 W. 23rd Street.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 12 a.m. daily. Verify the day’s hours before travel.

cards.title: Papa Johns on Mississippi Street
cards.subtitle: 918 Mississippi St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery through the official store page and confirm the live close; listed hours are later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A pizza pickup or delivery option with 2 a.m. daily and 3 a.m. weekend listings.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns lists carryout and delivery until 2 a.m. daily and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 918 Mississippi Street.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Pizza — Mississippi Street, Lawrence
cards.access_notes: Listed carryout and delivery hours: 2 a.m. Sun–Thu and 3 a.m. Fri–Sat. Confirm before ordering.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Massachusetts Street
cards.subtitle: 922 Massachusetts St, Lawrence
cards.notes: Use the operator’s location page to confirm the day and place an order; late hours are listed specifically for Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A downtown sandwich destination whose official listing reaches 2 a.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John’s lists store and delivery hours until 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday at 922 Massachusetts Street.
cards.access_notes: Listed store and delivery hours: until 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday. Verify before going.
